title: Inclusive by Design: A Library's Small Changes
instructions: 阅读下面的短文，完成10个题目。题目类型包括单选、填空和判断正误/未提及。填空答案必须来自原文，且不超过字数限制。所有题目和选项均为英文，解释为中文。本材料为模拟教学材料，不是官方雅思试题，也不代表任何分数。
passage:
A city library recently finished a small but important project. The project was about inclusion and design constraints. The library wanted more people to use its reading rooms. But the building is old, and the budget is limited. So the staff had to make careful choices.

First, they looked at the entrance. The main door was heavy and hard to open. Many older visitors and parents with small children had trouble. The library installed a new automatic door. It opens when a person stands near it. The door cost more than a normal door, but it was the most useful change. "Now I can come in without help," one visitor said.

Second, they thought about the reading room on the second floor. There are many stairs, and there is no lift. Some people cannot use the stairs. The staff could not build a lift because the building is too old and the cost was too high. Instead, they moved the large-print books and the audio players to the first floor. They also added more chairs near the window. This was not a perfect solution, but it helped many people.

Third, they changed the signs. The old signs were small and the letters were hard to read. The new signs are bigger and use simple words. They also have pictures. For example, a picture of a book shows the reading room. A picture of a cup shows the café. The staff said, "Good signs help everyone, not only people who cannot see well."

Fourth, they started a quiet hour every morning. From 9 to 10, the library is very quiet. No music, no phone calls, and no group talks. This helps people who need silence to read. It also helps people who feel tired in busy places. Some visitors did not like the quiet hour at first. They said, "We want to talk." But after two weeks, most people agreed it was a good idea.

Finally, the staff asked visitors for ideas. They put a box near the door. People wrote their ideas on small cards. One person wrote, "Please add more lights near the newspapers." Another wrote, "The chairs are too low for me." The library will use these ideas next year. The project is not finished, but it is a good start. The staff learned that inclusion is not only about money. It is also about listening and small, smart changes.

questions.prompt: What was the main problem with the entrance?
options: The door was heavy and hard to open.
answers: The door was heavy and hard to open.
questions.explanation: 原文说“The main door was heavy and hard to open.”，所以入口的主要问题是门重且难开。
questions.evidence: The main door was heavy and hard to open.

questions.prompt: The library installed a new ______ door.
questions.explanation: 原文提到“The library installed a new automatic door.”，所以填 automatic。
questions.evidence: The library installed a new automatic door.

questions.prompt: Why did the staff NOT build a lift?
options: The building is too old and the cost was too high.
There was no space on the second floor.
The visitors did not want a lift.
answers: The building is too old and the cost was too high.
questions.explanation: 原文说“The staff could not build a lift because the building is too old and the cost was too high.”，所以不建电梯的原因是建筑太旧且成本太高。
questions.evidence: The staff could not build a lift because the building is too old and the cost was too high.

questions.prompt: What did the staff move to the first floor?
questions.explanation: 原文说“they moved the large-print books and the audio players to the first floor.”，所以搬到一楼的是大字本书和音频播放器。
questions.evidence: they moved the large-print books and the audio players to the first floor.

questions.prompt: The new signs use bigger letters and simple words.
questions.explanation: 原文说“The new signs are bigger and use simple words.”，与题目一致，所以是 True。
questions.evidence: The new signs are bigger and use simple words.

questions.explanation: 原文说“From 9 to 10, the library is very quiet.”，这是上午9点到10点，不是下午，所以是 False。
questions.evidence: From 9 to 10, the library is very quiet.

questions.explanation: 原文说“Some visitors did not like the quiet hour at first.”，说明并非所有访客一开始就喜欢，所以是 False。
questions.evidence: Some visitors did not like the quiet hour at first.

questions.prompt: The library will use the visitors' ideas next year.
questions.explanation: 原文说“The library will use these ideas next year.”，与题目一致，所以是 True。
questions.evidence: The library will use these ideas next year.

questions.explanation: 原文说“The staff could not build a lift because the building is too old and the cost was too high.”，说明没有建电梯，所以是 False。
questions.evidence: The staff could not build a lift because the building is too old and the cost was too high.

grammar.title: 比较结构、数量表达与指代综合；冠词和主谓一致检查
grammar.explanation: 本课重点是比较结构（如 more...than, the most...）、数量表达（如 many, some, most）、指代（如 it, they, this）以及冠词和主谓一致。比较结构用于比较两个事物；数量表达说明多少；指代要明确所指对象；冠词a/an/the要正确使用；主谓一致要求主语和谓语在数上一致。
grammar.example: The door cost more than a normal door, but it was the most useful change.

questions.prompt: This bag is ______ than that one.
questions.explanation: 比较两个包，用比较级 more expensive。
questions.evidence: The door cost more than a normal door, but it was the most useful change.

questions.prompt: ______ of the students passed the exam.
questions.explanation: 表示“大多数学生”，用 Most of the students。
questions.evidence: But after two weeks, most people agreed it was a good idea.

questions.prompt: The books are on the table. Please put ______ in the box.
questions.explanation: 指代前面的 books（复数），作宾语用 them。
questions.evidence: They also added more chairs near the window.

questions.prompt: She ______ a new phone last week.
questions.explanation: last week 表示过去，用过去式 bought。
questions.evidence: The library installed a new automatic door.

questions.prompt: There ______ some milk in the fridge.
questions.explanation: milk 是不可数名词，there be 结构用 is。
questions.evidence: There are many stairs, and there is no lift.

questions.prompt: I have ______ friends in this city.
questions.explanation: friends 是可数名词复数，用 many 修饰。
questions.evidence: Many older visitors and parents with small children had trouble.

questions.explanation: honest 以元音音素开头，用 an。这里引入一个非特定的诚实男孩，所以用不定冠词 an。
questions.evidence: The main door was heavy and hard to open.

questions.explanation: news 是不可数名词，谓语用单数 is。
questions.evidence: The staff said, "Good signs help everyone, not only people who cannot see well."
